working_memory.text: Demolition of Pellow Mill, agreed by the council last November and originally due to start in February, has been put back to the spring. A pre-demolition survey found asbestos in the roof sheeting and in the lagging on the surviving pipework, and the contractor appointed in January has since withdrawn. The council says a new contractor will be appointed once the asbestos removal is scoped, and that the hoarding on Bank Street will stay up in the meantime. Residents had asked for the site to be cleared before the summer.
